limitations: The ordinary Linux frontend does not yet instantiate the new consumer, second supervisor or delivery object. W-11 remains in progress.
Installed live inspector UI oracle, batching, current-profile intent, navigation/erasure, maximum-input responsiveness and topology/image qualification remain required.
Native positive policy is compiled into an unprivileged test fixture; protected deployment and all five complete native release editions remain unqualified.
Windows toolchain host tests are not execution qualification on Windows 9x/XP/7 or another historical system.
Ignored local evidence locators are not portable build dependencies; a fresh checkout reruns the declared commands in its own admitted workspace.
